description: Add a 3D file viewer to the HelpingHands iOS and macOS apps so the SO-101 gripper designs (Blender/OpenSCAD/Build123d outputs in cad/) can be viewed in-app. Support viewing any 3D file the bake-off produces (e.g. STL/OBJ/STEP/USDC as applicable); simple viewer screen reachable from the app, loading files from the repo bundle or imported files.
